cards.hint: Think about safety during the Revolution
options: to protect the cause of American liberty and their own lives
to celebrate reconciliation with Britain
to form foreign alliances with France
to draft a plan for confederation
cards.quote: The delegates to Congress adopted strict rules of secrecy to protect the cause of American liberty and their own lives.
cards.stem: Why did delegates adopt strict rules of secrecy in Congress?

cards.hint: Count how many colonies voted yes
options: the affirmative votes of 12 colonies are listed at the right
New York voted yes with the others
The vote was kept secret from the public
Virginia refused to take part
cards.quote: The document seen here shows the vote on the Lee Resolution — the affirmative votes of 12 colonies are listed at the right.
cards.stem: What does the document show about the vote on the proposal?

cards.hint: Recall the call for action and alliances
options: a declaration of independence
an order to end fighting in Massachusetts
a demand for new elections in Virginia
a pledge to protect the King
cards.quote: The Lee Resolution contained three parts: a declaration of independence, a call to form foreign alliances, and "a plan for confederation."
cards.stem: Which element was one of the three parts of the proposal?

cards.hint: Remember which colony delayed its vote
options: New York cast no vote
It approved treaties in September
It drafted the secrecy rules
It rejected the Virginia instruction
cards.quote: New York cast no vote until the newly elected New York Convention upheld the Declaration of Independence on July 9, 1776.
cards.stem: What happened with one colony during the initial vote?

no distractor occurs in its card quote (distractors-not-in-quote)
